name: Priya
label: Feature-watcher waiting on missing features
who: I'm a premium subscriber in the US on iOS who keeps up with new features and tests. I want the features I used to have back, so I track votes and beta tests to get them.
value_for_money: Expects features tied to premium and questions whether a removed feature was included in the free tier; one post relays that a feature will likely cost extra, and another says they would pay a one-time price for a similar app. No specific prices are given.
loyalty: Stays for the features and tests they hope to see; would leave if features stay removed or the new UI sticks, as one poster did when the mobile UI arrived.
pain_points: Features rolled out to some users only
Features that need a workaround to turn on
Features that disappear and come back
likes: Features they used all the time
tone: Analytical and curious, speculating about why features change and pointing others to votes and posts.
